verdicts.decision_note: The client identifies the previously shared video as the source material governing benefit claims in the ad creative.
The product-specific benefits remain materially unresolved between reference-equivalent claims and distinct Vedicurja strengths.
The client establishes that Vedicurja's advertised benefits should match those of the referenced products.
The client resolves the benefits uncertainty, allowing product-claim work to resume.
The client changes the ad-script benefit sourcing rule to combine claims from the winning script and last reference script.
First target-specific implementation claim: the supplied concept concretely incorporates the selected performance problems and presents Vedicurja as the solution.
The exchange changes reference-aligned creative direction, but it does not specifically establish the proposed benefit sources or benefit-selection rule for this Requirement.
The client establishes diabetes as the second product's indication and makes inclusion of that problem framing optional in the ad messaging.
Target-specific implementation claim for the revised 30-second script: it concretely includes the performance problem, Vedicurja solution claim, diabetes reveal, and second product.
